sloka: तथा ब्रुवति तारे तु तारा अधिपति वर्चसि ।अथ मेने हृतम् राज्यम् हनुमान् अंगदेन तत् ॥४-५४-१॥
transliteration: tathā bruvati tāre tu tārā adhipati varcasi ।atha mene hṛtam rājyam hanumān aṁgadena tat ॥4-54-1॥

translations.english: Hanuman listened to the proposal of Tara, whose face was like the Moon, lord of the stars. (After listening to Tara) he thought Angada might take over the kingdom from Sugriva.
